rules.answer_text: He came to me in the spring with forty years of exercise books in a fish crate and said the village should keep its own memory. I said yes before he'd finished the sentence. rules.answer_text: ...Very well. Yes. Six minutes, for the ceremony glasses, because nobody else was going to fetch them. rules.answer_text: Nine came and Elias didn't, which has never once happened in the history of this village. I sent Priya for the boxes at six past so the reading could begin the second he appeared. rules.answer_text: He failed me at every subject the school had and then told my mother I'd build things instead. Only teacher who was ever right about me. I've resented him and owed him my whole life, in about equal measure, and tonight I'd give the yard to have him back needling me by that fire.
